fields.System.Title: Add SSO callback handling to identity-service
fields.System.Description: Implement the OAuth2 callback endpoint identity-service needs to complete SSO login, part of AB#301.
fields.Microsoft.VSTS.Common.AcceptanceCriteria: Given a valid SSO assertion, the callback endpoint issues a session token and redirects to the app.

fields.System.Title: Add MFA challenge step to SSO flow
fields.System.Description: Require a second factor before issuing a session token for high-risk sign-ins.

fields.System.Title: Write onboarding docs for SSO rollout
fields.System.Description: Document the SSO rollout plan for squads adopting identity-service.
